title: Invoice printer
description: Each invoice line has a product name, a quantity and a unit price in whole cents; quantities and prices are never negative. Print one line per entry, in order, as `NAME x QTY @ PRICE = SUBTOTAL`, where SUBTOTAL is the quantity times the price. After the last entry print `TOTAL: N` with the sum of all subtotals. Return that total. An empty invoice prints only `TOTAL: 0`.
notes: Level 2. Record input. Products are stated with the declared field names. Largest test product 8e15, below 2^53 so TypeScript numbers stay exact. Empty name leaves a leading space.
